scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8787
scripts.start: cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8787
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend
